_comment: Project-scope MCP servers for the ops-light supervisor tier (cwd agent/ops-light-agent; CLAUDE.md is a symlink to ../ops-agent/CLAUDE.md, so every ops tier follows one rulebook). Chrome-less on purpose: only the ops tier loads chrome-devtools, and the router pins Chrome jobs (agent/config/chrome-jobs.json) to ops. No secrets here: ${VAR} placeholders are expanded from the environment, which process-manager.mjs loads from .env.
